title: Snowy 2.0 to cost 12 times more than initial budget with further delays
paragraphs: A major review into Australia's biggest renewable energy project has found it could cost up to $25 billion, which is about 12 times the original price.
Snowy 2.0 was initially set to cost $2b and come online in 2021.
The project is now expected to be delivered in 2029.
